violation_type.title: Notification of Reduction of Toilets/Sinks (26 TAC §744.301(3))
violation_type.typical_finding: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that 3/13 toilets available were not in working order and licensing had not been made aware of the temporary reduction of usable toilets.

finding_variants.text: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that 3/13 toilets available were not in working order and licensing had not been made aware of the temporary reduction of usable toilets.
Staff stated that they only have access to one restroom that has one toilet  for children.
